messages:
emma.partnerships: Quick kickoff: GearShift (HSM vendor) reached out about a joint marketplace listing + SSO/SCIM + KMS/BYO integration. Need to align owners, technical gaps, and a soft announcement window. :wave:
ajay.eng: I can take SSO + SCIM (they want SAML and OIDC). Will draft SCIM attribute mapping; note GearShift is group-first in their identity model. ETA: EOD tomorrow for a WIP spec.
lina.secops: Security notes: they assert FIPS 140-2 L3. We need vendor attestation, pen test summary, and a PKCS#11 + KMIP compatibility matrix before public listing. Also require SBOM and code-signing evidence for any connector binary.
emma.partnerships: From GTM: target a soft co-announcement in ~2 weeks and a joint webinar 4 weeks after. Is that realistic if engineering + security clear?
ajay.eng: Two weeks is tight but possible if we ship a feature-flagged SCIM endpoint and SSO docs. For KMS options: GearShift exposes KMIP and provides a connector binary for BYOK flows. Need decision: integrate via their connector or build native KMIP client.
mike.sre: If we ingest their connector binary in Dedicated/Private, we must package it, add automated smoke tests, and run hardware-in-the-loop verification. Recommend canary rollout: staging -> dedicated-test -> 10% prod -> full. Also include latency checks around KV cache warmup and cold-starts.
lina.secops: Also request a short threat model for the connector and a supply-chain verification. If they won't open-source, insist on signed artifacts and reproducible build logs.
emma.partnerships: Ajay, please open a PR for SCIM mapping. Mike, draft the canary runbook and owner. Lina, I'll DM you to collect attestation artifacts.
ajay.eng: Pushed WIP SCIM mapping to https://git.redwood.ai/partners/gearshift/scim-mapping — includes user/group attrs and sample payloads plus a curl example:
```ncurl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/scim/v2/Users -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"userName":"jdoe","name":{"givenName":"John","familyName":"Doe"}}'
```
Test tenant creds are in 1Password. I'll add OIDC discovery notes for SSO config.
mike.sre: Created runbook draft at https://docs.redwood.ai/runbooks/gearshift-canary — includes smoke tests, log flags, rollback criteria, and infra packaging steps. Need an infra owner to finish the packaging task.
lina.secops: Uploaded the security checklist to the same docs folder. Required artifacts: vendor attestation, pentest summary, SBOM, code-sign cert, and PKCS#11/KMIP compatibility proof. Marking these as gating items before soft public mention.
emma.partnerships: Agreed. Next steps: 1) Ajay finish SCIM+SSO docs (tomorrow) 2) Mike finalize canary runbook and assign infra owner (3 days) 3) Lina confirm attestation + SBOM (5 days) 4) I'll coordinate comms and rehearsal for the co-announcement.
ajay.eng: Will also write a short note on PKCS#11 vs KMIP support and recommend initial KMIP-only surface if time is constrained.
mike.sre: I'll ping @zach to schedule the packaging task and add a deploy-bot hook to automate canary promotion.
deploy-bot: Build artifact gearshift-connector:v0.1.0 uploaded to gs://redwood-artifacts/gearshift/1763339999 (sha256: abc123def456...); automated smoke tests queued.
emma.partnerships: Great. Let's meet 30min tomorrow 10:30am PT to lock timelines. If you can't make it, drop notes here. :calendar:
